quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2027 (March - August 2026) semi-annual report: net sales JPY 79,733 million (up 21.5% year on year), operating profit JPY 23,096 million (up 42.4%), ordinary profit JPY 24,538 million (up 68.4%, also affected by foreign exchange), net profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 15,839 million (up 45.7%). By segment: semiconductor & FPD equipment sales JPY 79,357 million (up 21.6%), segment profit JPY 23,969 million (up 43.0%); life science sales JPY 376 million (up 2.8%), segment loss JPY 147 million (segment loss JPY 119 million a year earlier).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 FY2027 net sales JPY 79,733 million (+21.5%); semiconductor & FPD equipment segment sales JPY 79,357 million (+21.6%), segment profit JPY 23,969 million (+43.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management's analysis of the half: total assets rose JPY 20,736 million from the end of the previous fiscal year to JPY 218,038 million, mainly on inventories up JPY 5,870 million (raw materials and supplies JPY 32,541 million versus JPY 26,642 million at February 28, 2026), notes and accounts receivable up JPY 4,398 million and cash and deposits up JPY 12,036 million; notes and accounts payable rose JPY 4,272 million. Operating cash flow was JPY 8,730 million (JPY 12,868 million a year earlier). Purchases of property, plant and equipment were JPY 1,761 million (JPY 522 million a year earlier). H1 R&D expenses totalled JPY 931 million (JPY 737 million a year earlier); the company states there was no material change in its R&D activities.
quarterly_data.figure: inventories +JPY 5,870 million; H1 PP&E purchases JPY 1,761 million (JPY 522 million a year earlier); H1 R&D JPY 931 million (JPY 737 million)

quarterly_data.signal: US patent suit (filed August 30, 2022 against Rorze and its US subsidiary Rorze Automation, Inc.; jury verdict March 13, 2026): the parties signed a settlement agreement on August 3, 2026. In H1 the company paid JPY 9,587 million in litigation settlement (operating cash flow), the JPY 7,429 million provision for loss on litigation booked in the year to February 2026 was released, and the difference was recorded as an extraordinary loss of JPY 2,158 million. Terms are confidential; the company states the suit is finally resolved with no impact on future business activities.
quarterly_data.figure: litigation settlement payment JPY 9,587 million; provision JPY 7,429 million released; extraordinary loss JPY 2,158 million

quarterly_data.signal: Subsequent event: on September 1, 2026 Rorze's wholly owned subsidiary RORZE CREATECH CO., LTD. (Shanghai) established a wholly owned subsidiary, Rorze Createch Precision Technology, in Shanghai, China, to produce, develop and sell automated wafer-transfer equipment and provide technical support and import / export agency (capital about JPY 476 million). The company states that, with demand for semiconductor-related equipment for the Chinese market growing, strengthening its production system in China is an issue, and in particular raising the production capacity of RORZE CREATECH SEMICONDUCTOR EQUIPMENT CO., LTD. (RCS) is urgent. Rorze and other subsidiaries plan to sell products to the new company; its operations are scheduled to start next spring, so the impact on this fiscal year's consolidated results is minor.
quarterly_data.figure: new Shanghai production subsidiary established September 1, 2026; capital about JPY 476 million; operations from next spring
